summary: Accumulates a per-frame steering delta a1 (char, passed in bl) into a byte accumulator at a2 + 51. When that signed addition does not set the flag composite (no overflow/zero), it records the target object pointer a2 at _ESI + 12 and the delta a1 at _ESI + 16. The rcr instruction and the 'sp value detected' warning are decompiler artifacts; the ABI is a register-based __usercall.

operations.description: Compute the flag composite v3 from a1 + *(BYTE)(a2 + 51): (sign bit XOR overflow bit) OR zero flag. This captures the signed-add condition that later gates the store.
Accumulate the steering delta into the byte counter: *(BYTE)(a2 + 51) += a1.
rcr byte ptr [esi-7Fh], 0C4h appears in the raw source but is decompiler noise from the register-based calling convention; it does not correspond to the store logic.
Branch on !v3: the state update is performed only when the accumulation did not set the flag composite.
Store the target object pointer into the state object: *(_DWORD *)(_ESI + 12) = a2.
Store the steering delta into the state object: *(_BYTE *)(_ESI + 16) = a1.
Register-based __usercall ABI: a1 in bl, a2 in edi, state base in esi; the positive-sp warning marks the disassembly as potentially unreliable around the rcr artifact.

clean_pseudocode: // a1: steering delta (char, bl); a2: target object; _ESI: steering state
v3 = signed_add_flags(a1, obj.byte[51]);   // Hex-Rays flag composite
unresolved: Exact flag semantics of v3 (sign-bit XOR overflow OR zero) are a Hex-Rays artifact of the original flags capture; only the conditional-store behavior is certain.
Meaning of the rcr instruction is not resolvable from this packet; treated as decompiler noise.
Identity of the state object _ESI and the target object a2 is not established; the +12/+16 and +51 offsets have no named field mapping here.
